purpose: Keep the photography-led redesign expressive, legible, public-safe, and accountable as the site evolves.

criteria.name: Photography is structural
criteria.criterion: The homepage uses a real selected photograph as its full-bleed hero and includes image-led editorial sequences below the first viewport.

criteria.name: Stable image geometry
criteria.criterion: Shared image components reserve aspect ratios so photographs, captions, and loading states do not shift the page.

criteria.name: Situated captions
criteria.criterion: Every selected archive photograph has non-empty alt text, caption, credit, context, and a stable public identifier.

criteria.name: Collective credit
criteria.criterion: Campaign sequences explicitly resist sole-authorship implications and describe Jamie's role within collective work.

criteria.name: Public-safe derivatives
criteria.criterion: Committed image derivatives contain no embedded metadata, private local paths, library UUIDs, or held-sensitive asset references.

criteria.name: Human publication gate
criteria.criterion: The repository states that final rights, credit, crop, represented-person dignity, and production approval remain human decisions.

criteria.name: Human Index material system
criteria.criterion: The global theme uses the approved work-jacket blue, institutional green, red-pencil accent, graphite, and corroboration colors without gradient decoration.

criteria.name: Hiring path remains clear
criteria.criterion: Photography does not displace the role-fit path, resume, selected work, or contact actions.

criteria.name: Practice remains plural
criteria.criterion: The about page and project pages connect artistic, civic, technical, and social practice without reducing every image to organizational utility.

criteria.name: Responsive first viewport
criteria.criterion: Header, hero type, commands, and a hint of following content fit without overlap at mobile and desktop widths.
